skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the organization and functions of computer systems and operating systems, including task management, process synchronization, disk management, file systems, peripheral management, and system protection and security.
Apply problem-solving techniques to real-world operating system issues, including process communication and synchronization, deadlock prevention, and recovery.
Collaborate effectively in group projects, manage tasks, and present solutions related to operating systems.
Develop the ability to work independently, understand responsibilities, and adhere to professional ethics.
Implement process tree and thread creation, and apply process communication and synchronization techniques in practical programming.
Understand and apply security measures in operating systems, including access control and encryption techniques.
Manage main memory, virtual memory, and disk storage, including fragmentation and swap management.
Design and manage file systems, including directory structures, file access, and permissions.
Implement disk scheduling algorithms and manage disk storage effectively.
Understand and manage input/output operations, including DMA and interrupt control.
